verdict.rationale: Anthropic ships an explicit skill-creator meta-skill that creates new skills, iteratively improves them, and benchmarks performance/triggering accuracy, plus a canonical template SKILL.md and a public open spec (agentskills.io) defining required frontmatter, folder structure, and file conventions — together covering end-to-end authoring and packaging. Community reports (comm-4, comm-5) corroborate real-world use of authored skills, though multiple users report triggering/discovery reliability issues once packaged (comm-6/7/9/11/12) which is a secondary caveat rather than a failure of the authoring workflow itself. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of the skill-creator meta-skill workflow (vs. just docs), and stronger evidence that agent-authored skills reliably self-trigger post-packaging.
